note: Evidence abridged by the author from the critic's full report; verdicts and preference verbatim.
reads_as_reason: Cuboid rounded-box head, stacked rounded-block segments with no taper, and oversized shoulders and arms read as a blocky character figure.

G1.evidence: Squared head with a flat top; stacked torso blocks; wide splayed arm slabs; untapered leg columns (P3 0.422, P2a 0.1324).

G2.evidence: Pelvis tub overhangs the thighs; shoulder box steps onto the chest; joint bands are thin lines only at shoulder, elbow, wrist; the knee reads as a seam in one white column (P8a 0.9626, P8b 0.9242).

G3.evidence: Warm-white shells, graphite only at joint lines, hands, feet and a thin visor slit; cleaner than the baseline's shoulder and forearm blotches.

G4.evidence: Radii broadly uniform and all sections squarish: consistent, but the consistency of a block set; S4b 0.6186.

G6.evidence: Much wider than both references; square head vs ovoid references; long feet. Matches head, hip and knee heights and the white-over-black split. IoU 0.5266 / 0.5578.

pairwise.evidence: Silhouettes practically identical; the candidate's two-tone is calmer (thin visor slit, thin bands) against the baseline's large visor block and blotches; 13/19 vs 12/19 and P9b passes. The baseline has the more convincing knee recess and the more Optimus-like full visor; small margin.

top_changes.change: Narrow the shoulders, bring the arms in, make the upper arm a tapered capsule.
Taper the legs, reduce the pelvis overhang, add a visible dark knee recess (narrower than the baseline's).
Lengthen the neck, soften the head toward an ovoid (lower n), shorten the foot.

notes: Clay views flat-shaded; rear pack and heel block not evaluated.
